summary.text: Mike Wilson is a Republican state senator from Kentucky who has represented District 32 since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as general manager of Bowling Green Community Broadcasting/Christian Family Radio.

paragraphs.text: Wilson served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1972 to 1981 and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from California State University, Fullerton, in 1986.
His professional experience includes work as general manager of 90.7 WCVK and as administrator and assistant pastor of Calvary Chapel of South Bay.
Wilson took office in the Kentucky State Senate on January 1, 2011.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Senate Committee on Committees, Economic Development, Tourism and Labor, Agriculture, Education, Transportation, Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection, and Rules committees.
